controllerType: K4-D Electronic Control Box (2-digit 7-segment LED display)
type: Interlock (overlock) sewing machine electronic control box

specs.factoryResetMethod: Long press ▼ for 3 seconds in P interface (J4, J5 monitoring data excepted from reset)
specs.engineerAccess: Long press ▲ and ▼ together for 3 seconds in P interface — enters engineer interface, displays 'F'

errorCodes.cause: Motor stuck (电机堵转) — motor run out of load capacity, motor plug loose or dropped off, sewing material too heavy, machine lacks lubrication
errorCodes.solution: Reduce the load capacity for the motor and restart. Check if plug of motor is loose or has dropped off. Check if the sewing material is too heavy. Check if the machine needs lubrication.

errorCodes.cause: Software over-current (软件过流) — motor load too large
errorCodes.solution: Turn off power and power on again. If alarm cannot be eliminated: motor used too much — restart machine after several minutes, then check if fabric is much too heavy.

errorCodes.cause: Parameter save abnormal (参数保存异常) — parameter storage failure
errorCodes.solution: Turn off power and power on again after a moment. If problem persists: restore factory defaults (long press ▼ for 3 seconds). If problem unsolved, contact dealers.

errorCodes.cause: Hall signal of motor abnormal (电机霍尔信号异常) — motor encoder plug unreliable, encoder signal wire broken, pin exited or deformed
errorCodes.solution: Check if the 10-core line connects well. Check if the connect line of Hall sensor is well or not.

errorCodes.cause: Synchronizer signal abnormal (定位器信号异常) — synchronizer cable not inserted or upper/lower needle position signals not working
errorCodes.solution: Forget to insert the synchronizer cable before turning on the machine. Check that the synchronizer cable is connected to the controller. Check both up needle position signal and down needle position signal are working.

errorCodes.cause: Speed governor abnormal (调速器异常) — presser foot not returned to correct position, safety switch button damaged, or outlet/plug abnormal
errorCodes.solution: Check if the presser foot is back to the correct position. Check if the safety switch button is damaged. Check if the outlet/plug is normal.

errorCodes.cause: Current detection circuit fault (电流检测电路故障) — circuit board dirty, power supply voltage abnormal, or power board functions abnormal
errorCodes.solution: Check whether the circuit board is clean. Check whether the power voltage is normal. Wait for power to be restarted/reset (carefully check each function of the power board).
Switch off the power and restart. Check whether the supply voltage is normal. Try to restore factory defaults.

errorCodes.cause: System over-voltage (系统过电压) — supply voltage too high
errorCodes.solution: Immediately switch off the power. Check whether the supply voltage is too high. If yes, adjust the rated voltage, then start to work (rated voltage: 220V).

errorCodes.cause: System under-voltage (系统欠电压) — voltage abnormal or too low
errorCodes.solution: Check if the voltage is normal. Wait for power to be restarted/reset (carefully check each function of the power board). Alternatively recover factory reset.

errorCodes.cause: Brake resistor protection (刹车电阻保护) — brake resistor plug loose or dropped off, supply voltage abnormal
errorCodes.solution: Check whether the plug of brake resistor is loose or has dropped off. Check whether the supply voltage is normal. Try to restore factory defaults or restart.

parameters.name: Speed limitation
parameters.note: Decline by 500rpm every time. Value 50 = 5000 RPM.

monitoring.name: Historical voltage
monitoring.note: Displays historical lowest and highest input voltage

monitoring.name: Cumulative running time
monitoring.note: Displayed number × 100 = actual time in hours (Note: manual says ×10 per some versions)

troubleshooting.symptom: E3 parameter save error on K4-D interlock machine
checks: Turn off power completely, wait a moment, then power on again
If error persists, perform factory reset: long press ▼ for 3 seconds in P interface
Note: J4, J5 monitoring data will NOT be reset
If still unresolved, contact Jack dealer or service agent

troubleshooting.symptom: E5 synchronizer signal error on K4-D
checks: Check that the synchronizer/positioner cable is inserted into the control box before powering on
Check both up and down needle position signals by slowly rotating the hand wheel
Verify the synchronizer disc is clean and not damaged
Inspect the synchronizer sensor gap and alignment

troubleshooting.symptom: Ed brake resistor protection error on K4-D
checks: Check whether the brake resistor plug is firmly connected and not loose
Inspect the brake resistor wire for damage
Check supply voltage is within normal range (220V ±10%)
Try factory reset (long press ▼ for 3 seconds) or restart
The brake resistor dissipates energy when motor decelerates — check it is not overheated or burned

troubleshooting.symptom: E6 speed governor error on K4-D interlock machine
checks: Check that the presser foot has returned to its correct home position after thread trimming
Inspect the presser foot safety switch — press it and check if it clicks normally
Check the speed governor/pedal connection plug at the control box
If safety switch is damaged, the machine will give E6 alarm
